caption: uranus turns direct today at 1.7° gemini. it only looked like it was going backwards.

slides.headline: *gemini*, uranus stops reversing in your sign today
*uranus* pauses, then moves forward again
slides.body: from earth, uranus has looked like it was drifting backwards for months. today it stations and turns direct. astrologers read uranus as change you didn't plan.

slides.headline: you can want *change* and still pick a person
say what you *actually* want, then let it surprise you
